implemented.input: XYZWPR, POSITION and XYZWPREXT values, groups, constructors, geometry and typed routine/service results; JOINTPOS through explicit forward context
implemented.capture: Evaluate, snapshot and validate/convert source before capturing output selectors in order; source may also be output storage
implemented.outputs: Retain seven exact writable output references, disjoint output footprints, protected storage and FOR guards; preflight entire output batch
implemented.representations: XYZWPR/XYZWPREXT preserve supplied components; POSITION uses existing proper-matrix validation and canonical Euler conversion; external fields validated but omitted

implemented.current: Bare and explicit zero-argument CURPOS/CURJPOS discard both masks, retaining ordinary query context and shadowing priorities
implemented.observations: unpos_calls, unpos_policy, existing direct/transitive writes, joint conversion sites/service effects and value-free request records

Allow source/output aliases through a detached source snapshot; duplicate output aliases remain blocked
No angle normalization for direct XYZWPR/XYZWPREXT fields; POSITION follows existing Z-Y-X and gimbal conventions
Validate complete extended metadata without adding external-axis output slots
Cartesian-only extraction needs no service; joint/current inputs use explicit services without updating robot state
Preserve old strict compilation and the conservative runtime.unpos helper
